text:
devon: Heads up - intermittent nvme I/O "ping-pong" on us-west3 causing GPU attach queuing. noticed after overlayfs mount tweak last night.
aj: node id? logs?
maria: timeline please.
devon: gnode-uw3-238, started ~15:10 UTC. dmesg shows repeating blk_update_request I/O errors then normal. attach latency for GPU pods spikes.
ops-bot: ALERT: nvme_iops_flicker detected on gnode-uw3-238 (4.2x baseline) - runbook /runbooks/nvme-iops-flicker
aj: paste dmesg snippet
devon: paste: 
[15:10:12] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 9876543
[15:10:21] nvme: I/O 0x9ab timeout
[15:10:21] blk_update_request: read error, dev nvme0n1
[15:10:30] I/O completed ok
[15:10:39] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 9877001

liam: ~9s spacing - matches janitor/trim window we adjusted in the scheduled cleaner rollout. cleaner may be colliding with small-R/W GPU workloads.
sofia: overlayfs flag change could increase write-amplification for small files.
maria: can we skip janitor on that host to validate?
devon: applied tag `janitor:skip=1` to gnode-uw3-238. monitoring.
ben: any SMART numbers? wear?
devon: SMART: media_errors rising, bad_blocks incrementing. wear_level ~72%. serial NVME-ABC-238. not failing fully yet.
aj: if it's wear + ekstra write-amplification -> avoid aggressive scrub. we should evac GPUs.
liam: mitigation plan: 1) skip janitor on affected nodes, 2) drain high-churn batch jobs to spare pool (3-5min), 3) throttle small-IO processes using cgroups/ioprio.
devon: draining now, migrating 3 pending gpu jobs -> spare-pool-us-west3.
sofia: don't change overlayfs globally yet, prefer host-level mitigations.
maria: @liam can you lead for the next hour?
liam: taking lead; coordinating with storage.
ops-bot: NOTE: auto-migration triggered for jobs job-11011..job-11013 -> spare-pool-us-west3
ben: if repeated, open replacement ticket and warranty check.
devon: filed INFRA-4521 with SMART dump + dmesg.
aj: after drain, run short fio 4k randrw to validate.
devon: running fio 30s now. posting output:
fio --name=randrw --rw=randrw --bs=4k --size=1G --runtime=30
-- when janitor SKIP set: IOPS ~11.8k, p95 latency 14ms
-- when janitor allowed: IOPS ~1.9k, p95 latency 110ms

sofia: clear correlation. we'll add jitter/backoff to janitor cadence to avoid synchronized bursts and reduce write pressure.
liam: opening STOR-364 to add jitter, dynamic backoff, and host-level skip heuristics. also recommend canary rollback of overlayfs flags in a controlled region.
maria: note on cost/ops: migrations increase GPU churn and scheduler load; prefer targeted draining rather than region-wide moves.
devon: followups: 1) keep node skipped for 24h, 2) schedule nvme replacement if errors continue, 3) run deeper SMART + vendor diag.
ben: adding node to watchlist and marking spare candidate.
liam: storage team - please review SMART and consider preemptive replacement if media_errors trend upward.
maria: thanks team. update if attach latency or I/O errors reappear. :thumbsup:
